description: Test whether TANC2 pathogenic truncating variants cluster in domains or are uniformly distributed
code:
import requests, json, time, re
import pandas as pd, numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy import stats
eutils="https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/"
def get(url,params,tries=6):
    for k in range(tries):
        r=requests.get(url,params=params,timeout=120)
        try: return r.json()
        except Exception: time.sleep(3)
    raise RuntimeError
s=get(eutils+"esearch.fcgi",{"db":"clinvar","term":'TANC2[gene]',"retmax":1000,"retmode":"json"})
ids=s["esearchresult"]["idlist"]; rows=[]
for i in range(0,len(ids),200):
    es=get(eutils+"esummary.fcgi",{"db":"clinvar","id":",".join(ids[i:i+200]),"retmode":"json"})
    res=es.get("result",{})
    for uid in res.get("uids",[]):
        d=res[uid]; g=d.get("germline_classification",{})
        rows.append({"title":d.get("title",""),"clinsig":g.get("description","")})
    time.sleep(1.0)
df=pd.DataFrame(rows)

AA_LEN=1990  # UniProt Q9HCD6 canonical; NM_001394998.1 encodes the long isoform
# parse protein position
three={'Ala':'A','Arg':'R','Asn':'N','Asp':'D','Cys':'C','Gln':'Q','Glu':'E','Gly':'G','His':'H','Ile':'I',
'Leu':'L','Lys':'K','Met':'M','Phe':'F','Pro':'P','Ser':'S','Thr':'T','Trp':'W','Tyr':'Y','Val':'V','Ter':'*'}
def parse(t):
    m=re.search(r"\(p\.([A-Z][a-z]{2})(\d+)([A-Za-z]{3}|fs|=)",t)
    if not m: return None
    ref,pos,alt=m.group(1),int(m.group(2)),m.group(3)
    if alt=="fs": cls="frameshift"
    elif alt=="Ter": cls="nonsense"
    elif alt=="=": cls="synonymous"
    else: cls="missense"
    return pos,cls
def cclass(t):
    if re.search(r"GRCh3[78]",t): return "CNV"
    if re.search(r"c\.\d+[+-]\d+[ACGT]>[ACGT]",t): return "splice"
    return None

recs=[]
for _,r in df.iterrows():
    p=parse(r.title); c=cclass(r.title)
    if p: recs.append({"pos":p[0],"class":p[1],"clinsig":r.clinsig})
    elif c=="splice": recs.append({"pos":np.nan,"class":"splice","clinsig":r.clinsig})
v=pd.DataFrame(recs)
plp=v[v.clinsig.isin(["Pathogenic","Likely pathogenic","Pathogenic/Likely pathogenic"])]
vus=v[v.clinsig=="Uncertain significance"]
trunc=plp[plp["class"].isin(["frameshift","nonsense"])].dropna(subset=["pos"])
mis_vus=vus[vus["class"]=="missense"].dropna(subset=["pos"])
print("P/LP truncating with protein position: n=%d"%len(trunc))
print("VUS missense with protein position: n=%d"%len(mis_vus))

# H1: truncating P/LP variants are uniformly distributed across the CDS (expected under NMD-mediated haploinsufficiency)
ks=stats.kstest(trunc.pos/AA_LEN,"uniform")
print("\nKS test, truncating P/LP positions vs uniform(0,1): D=%.3f p=%.3f"%(ks.statistic,ks.pvalue))
print("Truncating positions: min=%d median=%d max=%d; last-exon-equivalent (>95%% of CDS, pos>%d): %d"%(
    trunc.pos.min(),trunc.pos.median(),trunc.pos.max(),int(0.95*AA_LEN),(trunc.pos>0.95*AA_LEN).sum()))

# H2: pathogenic missense/VUS missense enrichment in ANK(846-1227)+TPR(1244-1358) vs rest
ANK=(846,1227); TPR=(1244,1358)
def indom(p): return (ANK[0]<=p<=ANK[1]) or (TPR[0]<=p<=TPR[1])
dom_len=(ANK[1]-ANK[0]+1)+(TPR[1]-TPR[0]+1)
exp_frac=dom_len/AA_LEN
obs_mis=mis_vus.pos.apply(indom).sum(); obs_tr=trunc.pos.apply(indom).sum()
print("\nANK+TPR span %d/%d aa = %.1f%% of protein"%(dom_len,AA_LEN,100*exp_frac))
for lbl,obs,n in [("VUS missense",obs_mis,len(mis_vus)),("P/LP truncating",obs_tr,len(trunc))]:
    bt=stats.binomtest(int(obs),int(n),exp_frac)
    print("  %-16s %d/%d = %.1f%% in ANK/TPR, binomial p=%.3f"%(lbl,obs,n,100*obs/n,bt.pvalue))

fig,axes=plt.subplots(2,1,figsize=(13,7),sharex=True)
for ax,(d,lab,col) in zip(axes,[(trunc,"Pathogenic / likely pathogenic truncating (n=%d)"%len(trunc),"#C44E52"),
                                (mis_vus,"VUS missense (n=%d)"%len(mis_vus),"#4C72B0")]):
    ax.hist(d.pos,bins=np.arange(0,AA_LEN+50,50),color=col,alpha=.85)
    ax.axvspan(*ANK,color="#55A868",alpha=.18); ax.axvspan(*TPR,color="#8172B3",alpha=.25)
    ax.set_ylabel("variants"); ax.set_title(lab,fontsize=10,loc="left")
axes[1].set_xlabel("Amino-acid position in TANC2 (UniProt Q9HCD6, 1990 aa).  Green = 11 ANK repeats (846-1227), purple = 3 TPR repeats (1244-1358)")
plt.suptitle("TANC2 pathogenic truncating variants are spread uniformly along the coding sequence\n(consistent with NMD-mediated haploinsufficiency, not a domain-specific dominant-negative hotspot)",fontsize=12)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
